summary: Nova Supreme is an interactive space learning app that makes aerospace engineering easier to understand through hands-on exploration. We developed four 3D environments: Orbit Launch, Solar System and Landings, Lunar Base, and ISS and Satellites. Users can inspect spacecraft components, explore space systems, learn engineering formulas through the Equation Lab, and study historical missions. The app also features interactive lessons and a six-level Junior Training program with challenges, quizzes, XP, and achievements. By turning complex concepts into engaging, interactive experiences, Nova Supreme makes STEM education more accessible, encourages curiosity, and inspires the next generation of aerospace explorers.
details: Nova Supreme is an interactive space exploration application that introduces younger learners to aerospace engineering through four modules: Orbital Launch, Solar System & Planetary Landings, Lunar Base Operations, and ISS & Satellites. Students simulate rocket launches and spacecraft landings, inspect spacecraft, and operate a lunar outpost during a 72-hour mission. They balance oxygen, temperature, battery levels, electricity use, and experience how engineering choices affect mission success. The app also offers six lessons, eight equation calculators, a multi-event space timeline, and six levels of Junior Astronaut Training, where students complete challenges and earn XP. We used the software Node.js. Nova Supreme combines 3D environments with hands-on STEM learning. To run it, install the Node.js LTS, extract the zip file, open Windows PowerShell, navigate to the project folder with "C:\Users\YourUsername\Downloads\Nova-Supreme" , and press Enter. Run npm install, and once installation finishes, enter npm run dev, and open the local url displayed in PowerShell in your web browser. It shows the SI watermarks at the bottom of the project.
